proposal.root_cause: Misinterpretation of 'Rank'/'Top N per Group' and Aggregation Semantics (Missing RANK column, Wrong Partitioning)
proposal.what: Update system_prompt.md to explicitly instruct the model on handling 'Rank' queries (include a rank number in SELECT) and 'Top N per group' queries (use window functions or correlated subqueries for partitioning, not global sorting). This targets failures like bd0041 (missing PARTITION BY logic), bd00728 (missing rank column), and bd0928 (misinterpreting 'first' as position=1 instead of ranking logic or missing name parts).
